projects.title: kg-agent: a verification layer for knowledge-graph RAG
projects.context: TEEP research internship · CITI Lab, NTUST, Taipei
projects.summary: Three gates check every answer drawn from a Neo4j knowledge graph: is it faithful to its sources, are those sources trustworthy, and are they still current? If one fails, the agent retries.

metrics.label: end-to-end gate accuracy (15/20)
metrics.caveat: median of 3 runs; low-trust category only 1/5 correct

metrics.label: false-pass rate with the trust gate removed

projects.title: Turning news narratives into step-by-step text
projects.summary: A hybrid pipeline: rule-based NER and temporal analysis build per-article constraints, three LLMs convert the article under those constraints, and rule-based validators plus entity injection repair what the models drop.

metrics.label: articles keeping every mandatory entity, prompt-only vs full pipeline
metrics.caveat: 480 articles per model; still below the 85% target

metrics.label: BERTScore F1 across the three models
metrics.caveat: revised target ≥ 0.60 met by all three; the initial 0.70 target was reached only by GPT-4o-mini (0.700)

metrics.label: evaluation data points (480 articles × 3 models, 16 news domains)

projects.title: Ruang Topik: mapping Indonesian news topics
projects.summary: We scraped six national news portals, compared LDA, NMF and BERTopic, tuned BERTopic with Optuna, tested five embedding models, and shipped the result as a Streamlit dashboard for non-technical readers.

metrics.label: embedding choice moved coherence more than hyperparameter tuning
metrics.caveat: 0.075 spread across embeddings vs +0.021 from Optuna

image.alt: Ruang Topik dashboard showing the corpus and article counts per portal and category

links.demoNote: Hosted on Streamlit; it may take about 30 seconds to wake up.

projects.title: Secure Verification App
projects.summary: A cross-platform Flutter proof of concept that lets managers approve or reject internal requests (HR leave, finance verification, QMS) remotely, behind three authentication layers: registered device, app password and face recognition, with traffic tunnelled through a WireGuard VPN.

image.alt: Splash and login screens of the Secure Verification App

projects.title: Kinderfin
projects.context: Community service project (KKN Abmas) · MCI Laboratory, ITS
projects.summary: A web-based financial management system for a kindergarten. We gathered requirements through surveys and interviews with teachers, treasurers and parents, then built five roles (administrator, secretary, treasurer, teacher, parent) covering enrolment, tuition, extracurricular payments, payroll and household expenses. Co-led.

projects.title: Major.in
projects.summary: A web app that recommends a study major: forward-chaining rules plus an XGBoost model behind a Flask REST API, with a Next.js front end.

projects.title: WeapMath
projects.summary: A multiplayer educational math game, funded through the national student entrepreneurship programme (PKM-K) and registered as copyright (HKI EC00202495300, Ministry of Law and Human Rights).

projects.title: ASLora
projects.context: Course final project, written in journal-article format
projects.summary: The app translates American Sign Language (ASL) hand gestures into text in real-time by combining image processing and a YOLO-based object detection model.

image.alt: ASLora translating two hand signs into letters with confidence scores

projects.title: IndoBERT news classification
projects.summary: Fine-tuned IndoBERT to classify Indonesian news across four experimental scenarios.

projects.title: Fraud detection on synthetic mobile-money transactions
projects.context: Course final project, written in journal-article format (not published)
projects.summary: On an 83,561-row PaySim-style synthetic mobile-money dataset, compared class-weighted Logistic Regression and a Decision Tree, with SMOTE on the training set only.

metrics.label: F1 / PR-AUC, Decision Tree
metrics.caveat: synthetic data; ROC-AUC looks high even for weak models, so PR-AUC is the honest metric

projects.title: Sales dashboards in Tableau
projects.summary: Two views on a sales dataset: monthly sales, which climb from roughly 550K in February to about 1.55M in December with a sharp dip in July, and order value by US state, led by California.

gallery.alt: Line chart of sales per month
Map of order value per US state

projects.title: Sentiment of Mobile Legends reviews on Google Play
projects.context: Machine learning course final project · written up on Medium
projects.summary: Labelled Play Store reviews with VADER, then trained Random Forest, SVM and Naive Bayes on those labels. VADER is an English lexicon and misreads many Indonesian reviews, so accuracy measures agreement with VADER, not true sentiment.

metrics.label: Random Forest accuracy vs VADER labels
metrics.caveat: SMOTE before the split inflates this; other splits gave 52–71%

image.alt: Word cloud of Indonesian Mobile Legends reviews

projects.title: Resident happiness survey: KNN and K-Means
projects.context: Course assignment · written up on Medium
projects.summary: Classification and clustering of how urban-development factors relate to a person's happiness.

metrics.label: KNN accuracy (k = 3)
metrics.caveat: 67 test samples; K-Means silhouette 0.17–0.20 = weak cluster structure

image.alt: 3D scatter of K-Means clusters by street quality, house cost and police trust

projects.title: Stock price forecasting with a Transformer
projects.summary: Tested whether a small Transformer can forecast Microsoft's closing price, and whether an up/down framing works better. It could not: regression did worse than predicting the mean, and the classifier learned to always predict 'up'.

metrics.label: up/down accuracy
metrics.caveat: equals the share of 'up' days — majority-class baseline
